messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — onboarding feedback: users hit a bunch of friction around API key env vars + org/project scoping. They don't know whether to set REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_TOKEN.
jon: Ugh, seen that. Our sample apps use REDWOOD_API_KEY but CLI docs mention REDWOOD_KEY.
ryan: And the SDK currently errors hard if you set REDWOOD_ORG but not REDWOOD_PROJECT — unexpected 401.
marta: Exactly. New signups try a quick paste of the key into the sample app and get a cryptic auth error. We should make the default behavior more forgiving.
olivia: Is this a docs-only problem or do we need SDK changes?
jon: Both. Docs should show canonical env names and fallback rules. SDK should accept multiple env var names and prefer explicit args over env. Also, warn (not crash) if org/project are missing for APIs that don't strictly require them.
ryan: Proposal: SDK env resolution order: 1) explicit param in constructor, 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY, 3) REDWOOD_KEY, 4) RW_TOKEN. Also accept legacy vars for a transition period.
marta: +1. Also add a helpful error message that includes a link to the migration guide instead of just `401: unauthorized`.
jon: We can add a small compatibility shim in the next patch that does the fallback and logs a one-time deprecation warning. Example JS snippet to include in README:
```js
// resolution pseudo-code
const apiKey = opts.apiKey || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || process.env.RW_TOKEN;
if (!apiKey) throw new Error('Missing API key. See https://redwood.dev/docs/auth-env for setup.');
```
ryan: For org/project scoping: default behavior should be to call endpoints that don't need explicit project scoping without throwing, but attach a debug header `X-RW-Missing-Project: true` so clients still surface the misconfig.
olivia: That helps product too — we can detect onboarding dropoffs and follow up.
marta: Also need rotation story: when users rotate keys in the console, the CLI samples should recommend `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` but we should add a small `rw rotate-key` helper in the CLI that swaps env vars and can call the new key to validate.
jon: I can add `--auto-validate` to the cli command to hit `/v1/health` after update. If validation fails, it rolls back the env var and prints the error.
ryan: One DX bug I found: SDK retry middleware retries on 401 for idempotent calls which is wrong for auth failures. We should only retry on 401 when the error indicates token-expired with `www-authenticate` or a specific error code.
marta: Good catch. That explains noisy logs during rotation. Fix that in middleware and add unit tests.
olivia: Can we also update the sample apps to include a tiny `validateEnv()` snippet that prints human-friendly hints? New devs love copy/paste.
jon: Will do. I'll make PRs: SDK shim + retry fix + sample app update + migration doc.
marta: Can someone create a short runbook for support to handle rotation issues? A checklist: confirm key, test health endpoint, check org/project headers, rollback env var.
ryan: I'll open a support runbook ticket and link it here.
devex-bot: Automated ticket created: DEVEX-8723 "Auth env fallback + rotation UX" (assignee: jon). :white_check_mark:
marta: Thanks — timeline? I'd like the shim and sample updates in the next minor release, retry fix in the patch release.
jon: Targeting next minor (in two weeks) for shim/docs/samples, patch for retry this week.
marta: Great. I'll coordinate with docs and product for the migration guide and notify beta users.
jon: Ping me if you want a review of the migration copy.
ryan: Adding unit tests and CI job to ensure legacy envs are covered.
marta: Awesome. That should reduce onboarding support volume. :raised_hands:
